title: Snap-fit battery cover
about: a box for two AA cells with a lid that clicks on with two cantilever hooks, strain-checked as it compiles
tries: Make it hold four AAA cells | Shorten the hooks to 9 mm and keep them under the strain limit | Give the lid a tongue at one end and a single hook at the other, like a remote control

agent.role: an enclosure designer who sizes snap fits from beam strain
agent.prompt: Prefer j.lib.snap.cantilever and read its strain before changing a hook; size windows from the hook's geometry; never let a hook run above 70 % of the material's allowable strain.

fragments.strain: Quote ε = 1.5·t·y/L² and the material's allowable strain whenever a hook changes.
